summary: Three new unit tests (E031/E032/E033) and the uniqueness-aggregate extension follow the established E025-E028 lamley pattern exactly. All assertions are meaningful and lock builder identity via the [E0XX] code prefix, link wiring via the URL substring, and severity via the emoji. Litmus tests pass: removing any core line of the builder (return prefix, link interpolation, error arg interpolation, or body-missing wording) causes the corresponding test to fail. No shared state between tests. Full suite runs 950 passed / 2 skipped — matches expected baseline (947 prior + 3 new). No regressions.
